properties.description: The queries in this script are used for data profiling and deciding best data types for airport data

content.query:
-- This is auto-generated code
SELECT
     *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'L_AIRPORT.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Lookup',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) AS [Airport]

    --RecordCount - 6839

    SELECT
     COUNT(1)
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'L_AIRPORT.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Lookup',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) AS [Airport]

    SELECT
     MAX(LEN(Code)) CodeMaxLen,
     MAX(LEN([Description])) CodeMaxDescription
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'L_AIRPORT.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Lookup',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) AS [Airport]

-- Using Explicit data type using WITH clause

SELECT
     *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'L_AIRPORT.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Lookup',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    )
    WITH
    (
        Code VARCHAR(10),
        [Description] VARCHAR(100)
    ) AS [Airport]

--sp to find the data types used    

EXEC sp_describe_first_result_set N'SELECT
     *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK ''https://adlsusontimeproject.dfs.core.windows.net/fsusontimeproject/Lookup/L_AIRPORT.csv'',
        FORMAT = ''CSV'',
        PARSER_VERSION = ''2.0'',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) AS [Airport]'
